changelog: 0.11.7 - Fixed the seed tracker: Platinum/Legend capsules now show the real rarity of each cat (ubers were being shown as Rare/Super), the fake 'Super+'/'Uber+' labels are gone, fest slots show the true cat, names like D'arktanyan render properly, and the two side-by-side lists are labeled Track A (your next rolls) and Track B (the alternate path from a guaranteed 11-pull).

0.11.6 - New automatic seed tracking: roll in the gacha, close BlueStacks, hit Track seed. The app reads your seed straight from the save, pulls the live track from bc.godfat.org and shows what you'll roll next on every active banner (including Platinum and Legend capsules), then asks the AI for a concrete roll plan.
0.11.5 - The app window now brings itself to the front on start so it can't hide behind a fullscreen browser and look blank. The Downloading / Restarting statuses now show animated dots.
